mapper.select: SELECT tid, partner_order_id, partner_user_id, status FROM ( SELECT tid, partner_order_id, partner_user_id, status FROM pay_status WHERE tid = #{tid} ORDER BY ROWID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: update pay_status set status=#{status} where tid=#{tid}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rnum, a.* FROM ( SELECT p.partner_order_id as "partner_order_id", p.partner_user_id as "partner_user_id", p.item_name as "item_name", p.total as "total", p.approved_at as "approved_at", p.pay_idx as "pay_idx", ps.tid as "tid", ps.status as "status", ps.payload as "payload" FROM pay_status ps JOIN pay p ON ps.tid = p.tid WHERE ps.status = '환불요청' ORDER BY p.pay_idx DESC ) a ) WHERE rnum BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pay_status ps JOIN pay p ON ps.tid = p.tid WHERE ps.status = '환불요청'
select p.*, ps.status,ps.payload from pay p join pay_status ps on p.tid=ps.tid where p.pay_idx=#{pay_idx}
